verdict.rationale: ASC 718 expense reporting is a fair question for an equity management platform, but the evidence never mentions ASC 718, stock-based compensation expense or audit-ready expense reports. The adjacent features shown (409A valuations, ESS reporting, vesting schedules, cap table views) are related but are not the requested capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors
